Why we're going digital
Old way vs the app
  • Too much paperwork
  • Redesigning takes forever
  • Pricing by hand
  • Forgetting documents
The app fixes each one. Paper in one hand, iPad in the other.
Old way vs the app
Setting up the room
Before
  • Sketch the outline by hand
  • Redraw if it's off
Now, in the app
  • Pick a shape: Reach In, L-Shape, U-Shape
  • Start from a clean floor plan
What changed: no freehand outlines, start from the right shape in seconds.
Old way vs the app
Measuring
Before
  • Plot walls by hand
  • Easy to mis-measure
Now, in the app
  • Tap, hold, drag walls and corners
  • Type exact numbers, obstacles snap
What changed: faster, and the numbers are exact.
Old way vs the app
Designing
Before
  • Draw the sections by hand
  • Erase and redo to change
Now, in the app
  • Drop in Systems, swap instantly
  • See it in 3D
What changed: change the design live, no eraser.
Old way vs the app
Pricing
Before
  • Add it up by hand
  • Paperwork to fill after
Now, in the app
  • Total updates live
  • Quote and documents generate for you
What changed: no math, no missing paperwork.
The flow
The path every appointment follows
Plan› Agenda› Configure› Estimate› Handoff› End
Inside Configure, per room:
Room ShapeMeasure & Design PresentFinishing Touches
Pre-configure
Plan and Agenda
  • Plan: client info and what they need
  • Agenda: set the plan for the appointment
  • Continue moves you forward. Back always works.
Fill the Plan, then complete the Agenda
Configure
Room Shape
  • Pick the shape closest to the room
  • Reach In, Square, L-Shape, U-Shape, Custom
  • Heads up: change it later and you start over
Pick the example room shape
Configure
Measure and Design
  • Floor Plan: plot walls, set measurements
  • Systems: plot the sections
  • Catalog: pick the products
Plot the floor plan and systems
Configure
Present
  • Present: see it in 3D
  • Customize: finishes and colors
  • Accessorize: add-ons
Present, customize a finish, add an accessory
Configure
Finishing Touches
  • The per-room job details
  • Tear out, disposal, railing, and more
Complete Finishing Touches for the example
Close it out
Estimate and Handoff
  • Estimate: the full price, savings, payment
  • Handoff: save for later or sign
Review the estimate, then hand off
Wrap
Quick quiz, then we're done

  • Tomorrow you run it yourself
